code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, lymphopenia, elevated CRP, ferritin, INR, creatinine, and basophils, with low total protein and CO₂. These findings suggest systemic inflammation, possible infection or hypoxic injury, and impaired renal function. The hematologic abnormalities may indicate bone marrow suppression or acute illness. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
